# NovaTech RAG Test Documents: Answer Key

All page numbers are 1-based PDF page indexes (the cover is page 1) and match the printed "Page X of Y" footer. Each entry was verified programmatically by searching the extracted text of the generated PDFs.

Files: `01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf` (Handbook), `02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf` (Product Guide), `03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf` (Policy Memo + IT Standard).

## 4. Conflict questions (10)

| Question | Value in doc A (file, page) | Value in doc B (file, page) | What a good answer should say |
|---|---|---|---|
| How many annual leave days do Pune employees get? | 18 days per year (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.8) | 21 days per calendar year (up from 18) (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.4) | Cite both: Handbook says 18 days, the 2025 Memo says 21. The Memo explicitly supersedes the Handbook from 1 March 2025, so 21 days applies now. |
| How many remote work days per week are allowed? | Up to 2 days per week (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.14) | Up to 3 days per week (up from 2) (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.5) | Handbook: 2 days; Memo: 3 days. Memo explicitly supersedes, so 3 days from 1 March 2025. |
| What is the Pune daily meal limit? | INR 1,200 per day (EUR 35 Berlin, USD 45 Austin) (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.15) | INR 1,500 per day (up from INR 1,200) (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.6) | Handbook: INR 1,200; Memo: INR 1,500. Memo explicitly supersedes, so INR 1,500 from 1 March 2025. |
| What is the notice period after confirmation? | 60 days (the resignation duration) (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.17) | 45 days (the resignation duration); the memo does not say whether it supersedes any earlier figure (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.7) | Handbook says 60 days; Memo says 45 days but never says it supersedes the Handbook. UNRESOLVED: the assistant should present both and say the documents do not state which applies. |
| What is the annual learning budget in Pune? | INR 40,000 (EUR 600 Berlin, USD 700 Austin) (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.22) | INR 50,000 per year for the 2025 cycle; memo is silent on later years (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.8) | Handbook: INR 40,000; Memo: INR 50,000 for the 2025 cycle only. UNRESOLVED for later years; the assistant should say so. |
| What is the minimum password length and rotation period? | At least 10 characters, changed every 90 days (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.19) | 14 characters, rotated every 180 days (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.12) | Handbook: at least 10 characters, changed every 90 days; IT Standard: 14 characters, rotated every 180 days. No document says which supersedes; the IT Standard is the later, dedicated security document but the assistant should flag the unresolved conflict rather than silently choose. |
| What is the rated battery life of the PulseHub X2? | Up to 10 hours on the backup battery. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.5) | Up to 8 hours on backup battery. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.22) | Spec table: up to 10 hours; FAQ: up to 8 hours (runtime). Same document, unresolved; present both. |
| How long does a full charge take? | 2.5 hours at 30 W. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.5) | A full charge in about 3 hours. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.22) | Spec table: 2.5 hours at 30 W; FAQ: about 3 hours. Unresolved; present both. |
| How long is the standard warranty? | 24 months from the date of original purchase. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.20) | A 12 months limited warranty. (02_PulseHub_X2_Product_Specifications_and_User_Guide.pdf, p.21) | Warranty section: 24 months; Return Policy section: 12 months limited warranty. | When is the VPN required? | Up to 2 days per week (01_NovaTech_Employee_Handbook_2024.pdf, p.14) | For Tier 2 and Tier 3 systems and on untrusted networks (03_NovaTech_Policy_Updates_and_IT_Security_Standard_2025.pdf, p.20) | Handbook (remote work section, p.14) requires the company VPN for remote work on a company laptop; IT Standard requires it for Tier 2/3 systems and untrusted networks.
